items.title: Seedream 5.0 Pro - Live on Krea
items.excerpt: Seedream 5.0 Pro, an advanced image generation and editing model with web-search and deep-reasoning capabilities, is now live on Krea. It lets designers generate, edit, blend and batch images while holding visual consistency and art direction across multiple outputs.

items.title: What Is Seedance 2.5 and What Can It Do
items.excerpt: ByteDance's Seedance 2.5 video model, now usable in Krea, generates complete 30-second clips at up to 4K from a single prompt, adding stronger reference support and region-level editing over the prior version — a jump in controllable AI video for creative teams.

items.title: Lovable weekly update: reference connectors in chat, search settings, AI-generated image labels
items.excerpt: Lovable's July 8 release adds in-chat reference connectors, searchable settings, workspace insights and automatic AI-generated image labels to its conversational app builder — incremental workflow polish for designers vibe-coding full-stack apps.

items.title: Designing quality signals when AI makes everything look credible
items.excerpt: A UX craft piece on how designers can build trust cues — source transparency, validation, confidence communication and reputation — into products now that AI-generated content looks polished and credible whether or not it is trustworthy.

items.title: Meta's new Muse Image model accepts Instagram accounts as a prompt
items.excerpt: Meta unveiled Muse Image, an AI model that uses advanced reasoning to parse complex prompts, blend multiple photos into high-quality outputs and render legible in-image text — now powering Stories effects and WhatsApp image generation.

items.title: This ad says it's not AI slop, but that's exactly what worries me
items.excerpt: A Creative Bloq commentary on a brand campaign that markets itself as human-made, arguing the 'not AI slop' framing signals how anxiety over generative AI is reshaping creative advertising and how designers position their craft.
